items.reason: The eight students are assigned to two distinct places, each group explicitly requiring at least three members. Therefore the first place can have only 3, 4, or 5 students, and the solution branches exactly over those three cardinalities before counting 48+68+48. That finite admissible size range is a decisive Condition Core range. Requiring both sexes in each group is the composition structure of the selection task, not an additional positive-number key.

The student chooses four experiences from three named themes, at least one from each, then orders the chosen experiences. The (2,1,1) theme-count pattern is intrinsic to the categorical coverage/selection structure and drives the three combination cases before multiplying by 4!. No independent signed value or externally bounded mathematical variable is restricted; adding COND_POSITIVE or COND_RANGE would tag the ordinary structure of the combinatorics problem twice.
